resources.string: Finish matchmaking, your match, friend room or practice request first.

Guest progress can be lost if app data is cleared or the device is lost. Bind an email to recover it. Existing-account login does not merge guest coins or ELO. Offline progress and coins stay on this device.
Log out and start a new guest
Guest coins and ELO are not merged with the account you log in to. The previous guest is securely retained for explicit recovery. Offline data stays unchanged.
The server session must be revoked successfully before local credentials change. You will start a new guest. Bind your guest first to avoid losing access. Offline data is not deleted.
Your account enters a 7-day pending deletion period and sessions end. Use Cancel pending deletion with your email and password within 7 days. Offline data is not deleted.
Remove expired identity from this device only
This does not log out server sessions. The identity is already expired or revoked. Removing it starts a new guest; guest progress may no longer be recoverable. Offline data stays unchanged.
Only the saved guest secret is used. A response with a different user ID is rejected. If you just bound an email, log in with that email instead.
Accounts require WSS/HTTPS. Debug local HTTP additionally requires PK_AUTH_ALLOW_HTTP=true on the server. No default TLS domain is assumed.
Your verified email account can be used on other devices. Online coins and ELO belong to this account; offline progress remains separate.
Trust HTTPS address and migrate old guest

Old environment: %1$s
Trusted target: %2$s
Old user ID: %3$d
Your old credential will be sent to this target for one migration attempt. Only confirm if you trust its operator. Failure retains the old credential and environment; success preserves your user ID.
